description: This Kotlin source file defines the ViewModel class 'TicTacToeViewModel' for managing the state of a TicTacToe game in an Android app. It includes properties for the game board, current turn, game over status, and winning line, as well as methods for handling cell taps, resetting the game, and saving/restoring state via a Bundle. It also contains an enum 'MoveResult' representing possible move outcomes.

classes.name: TicTacToeViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing the TicTacToe game state, providing functionality to handle moves, game reset, and state persistence.

classes.name: MoveResult
classes.description: An enum class representing the result of a move in the game, such as continuing the game, a win, draw, or no operation.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles a cell tap at a given index, applying game rules, updating state, and returning the move result.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game.

methods.name: saveToBundle
methods.description: Saves the current game state into a Bundle for persistence.

methods.name: restoreFromBundle
methods.description: Restores the game state from a previously saved Bundle.
